title: Repository State Contract (multi-repo, scope_fingerprint)
description: Snapshot taken before any v0.5.0 execution. Supports one or more Git repositories declared by the project's project-manifest.json. Per-repository states are ordered (by repository_id ascending) and unique. Each entry has a per-repo fingerprint; the composite scope_fingerprint is sha256 of the joined per-repo fingerprints. The adapter_signature is NOT computed here — it lives in retrieval-execution-plan as sha256(scope_fingerprint + strategy + provider + normalized_query). The path is a repository-relative POSIX path. The equivalence cache is automatically disabled when any repository has dirty_worktree=true (CACHE_DISABLED_DIRTY_WORKTREE).

scope_fingerprint.description: sha256 of the ordered, newline-joined per-repo fingerprints (per_repo_id + ':' + per_repo_fingerprint).

path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path. No leading slash, no backslash, no '..' segment.

commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD. 'unknown' when not a git repo.

fingerprint.description: sha256 of commit + branch + dirty_worktree + index_status. Per-repo only. Required for the scope_fingerprint composition.
